name: Artifact data-model registry
summary: A URI-addressable registry of artifact data models — what a faktura, rachunek or paragon IS. Pydantic is the source of truth; JSON Schema, proto3 and example instances are derived from it, so any query can attach an artifact's expected structure as context over artifact://host/schema/query/get.
description: artifact:// puts the office's data models behind a URI so they stop living as scattered dataclasses. Each artifact (faktura, rachunek, paragon, document, contact, ...) is a single Pydantic model registered by id; everything else is derived from it, which keeps the four representations the flow needs in lockstep. artifact://host/registry/query/list and .../domains enumerate the catalogue; .../search finds a type by id/title/keyword. artifact://host/schema/query/get?name=faktura&fmt=json-schema returns the JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) you attach to a query so an LLM or validator knows the expected shape; fmt=proto returns a proto3 message (for gRPC/cross-language, wrapped by grpc/artifacts.proto); fmt=pydantic returns the typed field list. artifact://host/schema/query/example?name=faktura returns a starter instance, and artifact://host/schema/query/validate?name=faktura checks a parsed payload against the model — the gate before a flow trusts a scanned invoice. Pairs with invoice:// (which extracts the fields a Faktura validates against), camera:// (scan → paragon) and the sheet:// / sqlite-context:// stores.

optional: grpcio-tools (protoc) to compile the generated .proto into gRPC stubs

useCases: Attach the expected structure of a faktura to an LLM query (json-schema).
Validate a payload parsed by invoice:// against the Faktura model.
List every artifact the system understands, grouped by domain.
Generate a proto3 message for an artifact to share with a gRPC service.
Hand a flow a starter example instance of an artifact to fill in.
